Highly disappointed this visit .

I recently discovered this fantastic Punjabi spot that completely exceeded my expectations. The vibe is super trendy and aesthetic, making it an amazing hangout spot for catching a late-night cricket match with friends. Their menu features a wonderful variety of thalis with incredible combination options, and the portions are wonderfully generous. While the spices could be a bit bolder, my first visit was genuinely delightful. You definitely need to check this place out soon
